hvac_lines.desc: Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of variable speed pumping system consisting of Horizontal Endsuction pump with Stardelta starter controlled by dedicated microprocessor based pump logic controller with Modbus communication mounted separately in a control panel. The pump shall be driven by TEFC induction motor of class `F' insulation & IE 3 rating shall be considered for the pump motor energy & efficiency suitable for operation on 415 volts ±10%, 3 phase, 50 Hz A.C. supply. Panel mounted micro - processor based multi pump controller with VFD should also have provision for automatic alternate (cyclic) operation of pumps, multiple differential pressure sensor / transmitters as necessary, ON/OFF push buttons, selection of pumps mode on panel, adequate provision to terminate aluminum armounred power cable as incomer to controller incomer, earth terminations complete as per specification. The system shall be complete in all respect and suitable for following rating. The Pump shall be with vibration isolator as per OEM standard and proper pipe support arrangement shall be considered to avoid any kind of pump operation vibration issues.

Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning of Expansion tank with air & dirt separator unit pressurization pump control unit. SITC of CO Sensors.Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of Carbon monoxide sensors comprising of a carbon monoxide meter and a 0-10 VDC transmitter an all electronic system that utilizes a microprocessor to measure carbon monoxide (CO), calculate various calibration factors and analog output. The sensor shall average samples over a time period and update the output every 2 ½ minutes. The sensor is intended to be used in enclosed basement, where it shall provide CO data to building automation computers or controllers. A box shall house the sensor and provide an easy-to-mount, sturdy housing for the system. Sensors shall be mounted on walls or columns about 1600 mm above the floor. Sensors shall be evenly spaced and not put in corners, or directly in front of air inlets. Each sensor must have a cable directly to the control panel.
